messages:
maria: Heads-up — during argus34k-int3 onboarding I’m seeing a subtle quality drift when context >12k. Looks correlated with a short KV handshake window (~50-100ms) between prefill and in-flight tokens. Repro script attached.

chen: Can you paste the minimal repro and sample outputs? also which quant config?

maria: Quick repro command:
```bash
./run_kv_check --model argus34k-int3 --ctx 14000 --seed 42 --dump-kv --prefill-threading=single
```
Observed output (tail):
```
KV-accept: idx=11987 shard=3 seq=11987
KV-accept: idx=11988 shard=3 seq=11988
KV-serve: idx=11987 -> tok=5021
KV-serve: idx=11988 -> tok=ERROR_STALE
```

maria: So the KV entry that was just accepted is sometimes served as ERROR_STALE for the immediately following token. Happens ~1/200 runs.

oliver: Interesting. Could be RoPE scale slips under int3 quantization near shard boundaries. Did you try running with rope_scale_factor=1.0 vs 0.999?

maria: Not yet. Good idea. Also tried switching prefill threading to parallel and the failure rate went up.

cassie: We had a related flake on magnet bench — the handshake race showed up when prefill and streaming share the same accept queue. Might be a visibility window bug in the kvcache commit. @chen any recent commits to kvcache commit ordering?

chen: Only a tiny reorder from last week: "avoid double-flush on prefill commit" (CL 1234). I’ll bisect. Can you dump kvcache metadata (version, seq, commit_ts)?

maria: Dump attached in Gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abc123 — keys show commit_ts sometimes slightly lower than serve_ts.

oliver: If commit_ts < serve_ts due to clock skew + quant rounding, the serve path might consider entry stale. Two quick experiments:
1) run with FP prefill (no quant) — if flake disappears, quantization perturbation is likely.
2) force a tiny rope scale clamp on load: rope_scale=0.9995

Can someone run experiment 1? I'll do 2.

cassie: I'll queue an A/B canary on dedicated pool (canary-d) to run with FP prefill overnight.

triage-bot: [automation] created test run 3067891240 on canary-d: argus34k-int3 FP-prefill vs int3-prefill — see /runs/3067891240

maria: Thanks. Next steps:
- @chen bisect CL1234
- @oliver run rope_scale sweep 0.999 -> 1.001
- @cassie run canary FP prefill and collect KV-debug logs
I'll add a small regression test to nightly that stress-runs prefill+inflight overlap 10k+.

chen: Starting bisect now, will report earliest failing CL.

oliver: Started rope sweep job (0.999 0.9995 1.0 1.0005 1.001) on bench-02.

maria: thx. If anyone reproduces locally with the kv dump I can triage the handler code this afternoon. :coffee:
